svg.title: CRNN team backtest: traded price and cumulative P&L
svg.desc: Two panels sharing one x-axis, the position in the test set in thousands of one-minute bars (0 to about 143). Top: the VIXY price series the backtest trades sits near 11 to 14 dollars, then jumps 3.84 times within 3 bars, near bar 19,000, to about 44 dollars, and later ranges between about 40 and 89. Bottom: cumulative trade P&L with zero transaction costs stays near zero until the same point, steps up by about 25,000 dollars there, peaks near 50,000 and ends near 31,000. 240 long trades held across the jump make 79.7% of the summed P&L of 56,098 closed-trade records.
